set.body:
Current owner-approved direction, 2026-11-16: film and recall full event-graph delivery remains mandatory. The scientific preview and DL1-DL6 provide usable intermediate outputs in the same pipeline/bundle. Reuse existing film compiler F1-F6, identity/speech contracts, then the producer profile, detail-event bridge, anchored contexts, hierarchy/reference, temporal and causal slices, V1 exchange and terminal E0. See docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md.
Full means every declared family has an actual construction/admission path, positive/refusal witnesses, evidence-preserving exchange and a readout; it does not mean all facts are known. Per-fact unknowns remain explicit; an unimplemented family cannot pass as entirely unknown. Internal/external counts are derived analyses, independent of fidelity and phenomenology.
Engineering delivery and scientific qualification have separate finish lines. E3 typed matching/E4 structured decoding are experiments, never graph-construction prerequisites. Freeze all evaluated methods including DL6 before one joint untouched read; later changes need new confirmatory data. No numerical qualification threshold or access approval is ratified by this planning update.
